summary_1line: Vyasa teaches that wisdom, self-restraint, and yogic discipline are the raft and chariot that carry the soul across the perilous river of Time toward emancipation.

image_candidates.scene_text: A vast cosmic river filled with waves of months and seasons carries beings toward Yama while crocodiles of desire lurk beneath the waters.
A symbolic chariot made of body, senses as horses, scriptures as the whip, and the soul as rider moves along the pure path toward radiant Brahma.
A seeker clings to a fragile raft of knowledge while others sink in the dark river of Time, seized by crocodiles of desire.
